objects: one selected-face spell with an ordinary printed Storm descriptor
one Storm trigger per printed instance
zero or more independent spell-copy objects
state_reads: canonical spell-cast history for the current turn
source spell modes and X value
source spell target groups and snapshots
state_writes: ordinary stack resolution and copy cessation
costs: copies are not cast and do not repeat any original cost
timing: the count is locked when each Storm trigger is created and includes only other spells cast before the Storm spell that turn
targets: each copy begins with the copied targets and may receive independently revalidated new targets
choices: nontargeted copies are created without an invented choice
targeted copies use one public controller-only batch choice
same-controller simultaneous Storm and other cast triggers use ordinary ordering
hidden_information: the choice contains public stack and target references but no physical or logical authoritative IDs
apnap: Storm and every other represented completed-cast trigger enter one ordinary placement batch
layers: printed stack-zone descriptors do not claim granted, copied, removed, or text-changed Storm
replacement_effects: copied effects delegate to their existing typed replacement-aware owners when they resolve
copy: copies are not cast and do not increase a later Storm count
each copy is an independent counterable spell object
control_change: the casting player controls each Storm trigger and resulting copy
zone_change: the source spell or card may leave before the Storm trigger resolves without erasing the locked trigger
source_leaves: the trigger's immutable copy template survives source departure

variants: multiple prior spells cast by multiple players

implementation.supported_slice: Ordinary printed Storm on a trusted cast face, preserving represented modes, X, and public targets while excluding granted, copied, text-changed, conditional, face-down, and Gravestorm forms.

known_blockers: Gravestorm remains a separate untrusted keyword
granted, copied, removed, conditional, text-changed, and face-down Storm need trusted typed stack-ability propagation
copyable choices outside represented modes, X, and targets remain unsupported
aggregate casting, copy, trigger, and effect coverage remains incomplete
